description: Radeon Developer Panel UI settings reference ONLY (NOT a directly importable RDP preset). Provisional timer values are not verified dispatch/KV anchors.
profile: r6 QSA FA 64k paired, Vulkan b12133 marker-only
initial_capture_time_basis: Exploratory estimates from prior 64k process wall durations 208.485s code and 229.096s literature; include model load time. RDP timer origin may differ; confirm captured KV/N/q, never assume anchor.

fallback_if_no_timer_mode.trigger: manual Capture profile / hotkey at estimated workload stage; verify labels

after_calibration.note: Record actual calibrated RDP index from a successful capture. RDP index is not assumed equal to CPU vkCmdDispatch ordinal.

device_clocks: Do not change from the established setting between code and literature; log actual clocks. RGP capture can alter clocks.

required_target.q_global_window: 48640-48703 belongs to this physical UBatch, but markers refer to full N=1024
